difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a canonical morphism of complexes from the total complex of the tensor product of an internal hom complex with a third complex into an internal hom complex, functorial in all three variables. The author first records that the map exists by the general monoidal adjunction, then gives a direct construction: it interprets a degree n element of the target as a family of maps, uses the sign rules to write the differential of such an element as a sum of three terms with signs, writes the differential of a degree n element of the source in the same normal form, defines the map componentwise through the canonical contraction of a homomorphism and a tensor factor, and finally solves a small system of sign equations for the coefficients so that the construction commutes with differentials. The computation is carried out in full, including the finiteness verification needed for well-definedness.
